title: Re-review ex6 after its NOT READY review's blocking findings (round 2)
description:
Review the epic ex6 again, AS INTEGRATED, now that the blocking findings of its NOT READY review are fixed. This is review round 2; 2 count toward the bound of 2.

The previous review (0rt, decision 8) judged it NOT READY: deliver m1w's harness half (read the metering join from worker.json, compose the provider override, with a harness test) and make the close-out's protected changes leave 2pn's harness gate cell in .tick/runners.toml (the whole-file proposals wipe it); its blocking finding(s): "m1w's metering join reaches worker.json and no harness code reads it"; "Protected changes applied in key order wipe 2pn's harness gate cell".

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what still blocks it. A NOT READY that spends the bound is not reviewed again by the run unless the tree changes after it: it holds for a person with your reasons.
